name: Compilers
blurb: Short videos only: every pick is 20 minutes or less and covers one or two ideas, ordered as a sequence. Subtopics follow the Compilers guide in Topics.
method:
• Length: hard cap of 20 minutes per video; depth comes from a sequence.
  • Order: picks in a subtopic are in watching order; the first is the starting point.
  • Sources: Sorav Bansal (IIT Delhi) for IR, SSA, dataflow and register allocation; Neso Academy for the front end; short explainers for LLVM, MLIR and ML compilers, where good short material is thin.
